title_en: Supplementary Provisions (III) of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on the Determination of Crimes under the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China

articles.content_en:
October 25, 2007
Supreme People's Court Supreme People's Procuratorate
Supplementary Provisions (III) on Determining
Charges for the Implementation of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China
Fa Shi [2007] No. 16
Pursuant to the provisions of the Amendment (V) to the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China (hereinafter referred to as the "Amendment (V) to the Criminal Law") and the Amendment (VI) to the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China (hereinafter referred to as the "Amendment (VI) to the Criminal Law"), the following supplementary amendments are hereby made to the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Determining Charges for the Implementation of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China, the Opinions of the Supreme People's Procuratorate on the Application of Charges for Crimes Stipulated in the Specific Provisions of the Criminal Law, and the Supplementary Provisions of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Determining Charges for the Implementation of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China:
